name: synthesis-collections
description: The synthesis skills in five collections, each a plugin without hooks. The whole set, with the guards, the board and the rituals, is synthesis-skills in the synthesis-engineering marketplace.

plugins.name: synthesis-skills-core
plugins.description: The ground every synthesis collection stands on: thinking and grounding discipline, verification before done, project records that survive compaction and restarts, decision packets and action sheets, the skill router, the skills that install synthesis and keep skill copies true to their source, and editing a knowledge base in the Open Knowledge Format, which each new workspace starts with. It has no hooks and runs no synthesis runtime, so no guards, no board and none of the rituals' state: nothing in it checks a send, a deploy or a commit, or coordinates sessions, and a script that needs the runtime says so in one line. Where one of its skills describes those, it describes the whole set. The whole set, synthesis-skills, has all of them and every skill: https://github.com/synthesisengineering/synthesis-skills

plugins.name: synthesis-skills-project-management
plugins.description: Project work that outlasts a session: resuming a project in any harness, waiting on a bounded event, running a delegated task to the end, adversarial review rounds, keeping Claude Code, Codex and Muse in step, and capturing what a session learned into a knowledge base and publishing that knowledge base. It builds on the core collection: Claude Code installs the core with it, and in Codex and Muse you install both.
